title: Verify: Fonts are npm packages imported locally with no URLs
description: Read package.json and sources from disk and assert fonts are local.
acceptance_criteria: No font URL exists in src or index.html
technical_constraints: Unit test only; node fs reads

steps.action: Test 1: read package.json with readFileSync and assert dependencies has @fontsource/press-start-2p and @fontsource/vt323. Test 2: read src/main.tsx and assert it contains both '@fontsource/press-start-2p/400.css' and '@fontsource/vt323/400.css'. Test 3: read src/styles.css, index.html and src/lib/tokens.ts and assert none matches /https?:\/\/[^\s'"]*font/i or 'fonts.googleapis'.
